note: Every entry carries the ten fields §22.1 rule 2 requires (name, type, unit, range, default, scope levels, owner, description, change class, blast radius) plus the calibration status §22.4 requires. `specScope` records the Scope column exactly as Appendix A writes it; `scopes` is the §22.2 resolution levels it maps onto. Defaults are starting points for calibration, not recommendations (§22.4).

parameters.name: solve.window_min
parameters.awaits: measured arrival rate and round wall-clock per region
parameters.description: Lower bound of the adaptive batch window: the shortest a round may wait before solving.

parameters.name: solve.window_max
parameters.awaits: measured arrival rate and round wall-clock per region
parameters.description: Upper bound of the adaptive batch window: the longest a round may wait before solving.

parameters.name: solve.saturated_window
parameters.description: Batch window used when the shard is saturated and batching buys more than latency costs.

parameters.name: solve.max_legs_per_round
parameters.awaits: solve-time measurements at production Leg counts
parameters.description: Hard cap on the number of Legs admitted to one round; excess Legs wait for the next round.

parameters.name: solve.time_budget
parameters.description: Anytime budget for the solve step; on expiry the best incumbent is taken with its gap reported.

parameters.name: solve.improvement_budget
parameters.description: Budget for post-solve local improvement. Zero disables improvement without disabling the solve.

parameters.name: solve.branch_node_budget
parameters.awaits: branch-and-bound node counts on production instances
parameters.description: Node budget for the column-regime branch-and-bound search.

parameters.name: solve.fast_path_classes
parameters.description: Mission classes that bypass the batch window and are solved as a batch of one on arrival.

parameters.name: solve.max_generation_gap_regression
parameters.description: Release gate on column-generation changes: the largest permitted regression in the counterfactual evaluator's realised gap.

parameters.name: sim.max_optimistic_bias
parameters.awaits: the first one-sided simulator fidelity study against production
parameters.description: One-sided simulator fidelity gate: the largest optimistic bias the simulator may exhibit before it may discharge an obligation.

parameters.name: commit.max_serial_utilisation
parameters.description: ρ_max — the queueing utilisation ceiling of the serialised commit section, which bounds shard size (bound 2).

parameters.name: candidate.target_feasible
parameters.awaits: measured marginal quality per additional candidate
parameters.description: Number of feasible candidates the expansion aims to find before it may stop growing the radius.

parameters.name: candidate.max_evaluated
parameters.description: Hard cap on candidates evaluated for one Leg; truncation obliges the engine to record the achieved bound.

parameters.name: candidate.max_expansion_tiers
parameters.description: How many of the seven hierarchical expansion tiers a single search may traverse.

parameters.name: candidate.max_radius_by_sla_class
parameters.description: Maximum search radius per SLA class — an operational containment limit, not an optimisation parameter.

parameters.name: candidate.optimality_tolerance_cu
parameters.awaits: realised search-gap distribution once CU exchange rates are derived
parameters.description: Δ_opt — additive, CU-denominated optimality tolerance that terminates cell expansion. Additive because C* may be negative once C_opportunity is.

parameters.name: candidate.finishing_soon_horizon
parameters.description: How far ahead an agent counts as `finishing_soon` in the availability index.

parameters.name: feasibility.systemic_indeterminacy_threshold
parameters.awaits: observed indeterminate rates in normal operation
parameters.description: Fraction of candidates evaluating INDETERMINATE on the same predicate above which the systemic guard trips into Restricted Operation.

parameters.name: connectivity.max_heartbeat_age
parameters.awaits: measured heartbeat inter-arrival distribution per radio class
parameters.description: Oldest heartbeat that still counts as live state for commandability predicates.

parameters.name: connectivity.grace
parameters.description: Grace period beyond the heartbeat age before connectivity is treated as lost.

parameters.name: connectivity.max_deadzone_extension
parameters.description: Caps the p95-based lease extension granted for a known radio dead zone.

parameters.name: localisation.max_odometry_divergence
parameters.description: Largest divergence between reported position and its independent corroboration before F10 denies.

parameters.name: energy.event_budget_per_fleet_year
parameters.awaits: ops/finance/safety sign-off on the composed fleet-year budget (blocking decision B8)
parameters.description: The governed quantity from which every α[tier] is derived. Composed fleet-year event budget per shortfall tier: T1 contingency consumed, T2 return reserve breached, T3 hardware floor reached in service.

parameters.name: energy.shortfall_probability
parameters.description: α[tier] — the per-mission shortfall probability targets of F34. Derived, never hand-entered: a per-mission number chosen directly cannot be evaluated for adequacy and does not re-derive when the fleet grows.

parameters.name: energy.reserve_floor_wh
parameters.awaits: per-class pack specification and controlled-shutdown energy
parameters.description: E_floor — the hardware protection floor in Wh, below which the pack risks damage or the agent loses controlled shutdown. Never overridable.

parameters.name: energy.contingency_quantile
parameters.description: The quantile at which E_contingency is sized. Derived from α₁: configuring the two independently permits them to contradict each other invisibly.

parameters.name: energy.charger_availability_margin
parameters.awaits: measured projection staleness and realised charger contention

conservatism.compensates: staleness of the pinned charger availability projection

parameters.description: Conservatism margin applied to the pinned charger availability projection when computing E_return.

parameters.name: energy.charger_projection_max_age
parameters.awaits: the Charging Scheduler's published cadence (blocking decision B2)
parameters.description: Beyond this age the charger availability projection is refused and E_return falls back to depot-only.

parameters.name: energy.target_soc_max_age
parameters.awaits: the Charging Scheduler's publication cadence (blocking decision B2)
parameters.description: Oldest published target SoC the engine will consume before falling back.

parameters.name: energy.target_soc_fallback
parameters.description: Target state of charge used only when the Charging Scheduler's published target is unavailable. The engine never computes a target SoC.

parameters.name: energy.deviation_tolerance
parameters.description: Permitted deviation of realised from predicted consumption before mid-mission energy management intervenes.

parameters.name: energy.uncalibrated_reserve_factor
parameters.description: Reserve inflation applied to an agent whose per-agent consumption coefficient is not yet calibrated.

parameters.name: energy.max_combined_conservatism
parameters.awaits: an explicit Safety decision on the intended total energy margin
parameters.description: Publish-time cap on the product of all active energy-domain derating factors. Exceeding it is rejected at publish and requires an explicit Safety-class decision to raise — which is where a deliberate choice to be very conservative belongs.

parameters.name: payload.safety_factor

conservatism.compensates: uncertainty in declared payload mass against rated mass (F22)

parameters.description: Fraction of rated mass usable in feasibility. Declared in the payload domain and NOT multiplied into the energy conservatism product — a product across incommensurable quantities is not a meaningful number.

parameters.name: payload.packing_efficiency
parameters.awaits: realised packing outcomes per container model
parameters.description: Volumetric efficiency assumed by the tier-1 packing check.

parameters.name: commit.hardening_deadline
parameters.description: Lead time before execution at which a commitment hardens and stops being freely revisable.

parameters.name: dispatch.offer_ttl
parameters.description: How long an OFFER stays valid before it is withdrawn.

parameters.name: dispatch.retry_window
parameters.description: Window over which bounded delivery retries are attempted.

parameters.name: dispatch.nack_cooloff
parameters.awaits: observed rejection reasons and their persistence
parameters.description: How long a rejecting agent is passed over for the same Leg.

parameters.name: dispatch.systemic_threshold
parameters.description: Fraction of undelivered or unacknowledged offers above which the failure is treated as systemic rather than per-agent.

parameters.name: dispatch.max_delivery_delay
parameters.description: The outbox's maximum delivery delay. Bounds, with the offer TTL, how long a redelivered command can remain applicable — which is why agent.dedup_retention is validated against their sum.

parameters.name: agent.dedup_retention
parameters.description: How long an agent retains deduplication state. Below the sum of offer TTL and maximum delivery delay, a redelivered command outlives the state that would reject it.
parameters.derivation: Measured, not chosen: it is the maximum observed span between a command becoming deliverable and the last redelivery attempt the escalation ladder makes for it (dispatch.offer_ttl plus the ladder in §11.4), rounded up to the next whole minute. Publish-time validation A2 re-checks the ordering against dispatch.offer_ttl, so the two cannot drift apart silently.

parameters.name: agent.autonomous_continuation_limit
parameters.description: On-agent bound on autonomous continuation without supervision — the property that carries safety while I2 is suspended in a degraded mode.

parameters.name: lease.duration
parameters.description: Commitment lease duration. Expiry without commitment-scoped positive evidence triggers custody-aware recovery.

parameters.name: shard.lease_duration
parameters.description: Shard leadership lease duration; bounds the leadership-fence vulnerability window.

parameters.name: time.max_clock_skew
parameters.awaits: measured NTP skew across the fleet's hosts
parameters.description: Maximum clock skew the commit path tolerates before refusing to reason about ordering.

parameters.name: supervise.stall_time
parameters.awaits: measured legitimate-pause distribution per mission class
parameters.description: Time without progress after which progress supervision declares a stall.

parameters.name: supervise.max_timer_lag
parameters.description: Alertable ceiling on timer-firing lag; above it, supervision deadlines are no longer being met.

parameters.name: execute.eta_tolerance
parameters.description: Multiple of predicted ETA beyond which execution is treated as off-plan. Declared in the time domain; not multiplied into the energy conservatism product.

parameters.name: execute.start_grace
parameters.description: Grace period between acceptance and observable movement before the start is considered failed.

parameters.name: recover.max_reassignments_per_leg
parameters.description: Reassignment budget for one Leg before it escalates rather than cycling.

parameters.name: recover.incumbent_cooloff
parameters.description: How long a released incumbent is excluded from re-selection for the same Leg.

parameters.name: recover.resume_window
parameters.description: Window in which a suspended Leg may be resumed by its original agent before it is reassigned.

parameters.name: preempt.min_gain
parameters.awaits: CU exchange rates and an ops decision on preemption appetite
parameters.description: Minimum Φ improvement, in CU, that justifies preempting an existing commitment. Preemption is Tier 2 and ships disabled.

parameters.name: preempt.allowed_class_pairs
parameters.description: Which (preemptor class, victim class) pairs preemption may consider at all.

parameters.name: preempt.victim_immunity_period
parameters.description: How long a preempted Leg is immune from being preempted again.

parameters.name: preempt.max_per_agent_per_hour
parameters.description: Rate limit on preemptions affecting one agent.

parameters.name: fairness.weight
parameters.awaits: realised duty-cycle dispersion; Appendix A states the default only as "small"
parameters.description: Weight of the duty-cycle regulariser, in CU. Deliberately small: fairness is mostly an economic outcome, not a separate objective.

parameters.name: fairness.horizon
parameters.description: Window over which cumulative duty cycle is measured for the regulariser and the tie-break.

parameters.name: fairness.idle_alert_period
parameters.description: How long an agent may go unused before agent-starvation alerting fires.

parameters.name: reliability.halflife_days
parameters.description: Exponential half-life applied to reliability evidence, so old outcomes stop dominating current estimates.

parameters.name: health.unresponsive_strikes
parameters.description: Consecutive unresponsive dispatches before an agent is quarantined.

parameters.name: verify.arrival_radius
parameters.description: Distance within which an agent counts as having arrived at a Stop for completion verification.

parameters.name: verify.evidence_deadline
parameters.description: How long completion evidence may lag the completion claim before verification downgrades.

parameters.name: verify.track_min_fix_rate
parameters.description: Track plausibility test 1: minimum position-fix rate a claimed traversal must exhibit.

parameters.name: verify.track_min_corridor_fraction
parameters.awaits: measured corridor adherence on verified missions
parameters.description: Track plausibility test 2: minimum fraction of fixes that must lie inside the planned corridor.

parameters.name: verify.track_max_gap
parameters.description: Track plausibility test 3: longest telemetry gap a claimed traversal may contain.

parameters.name: assign.max_deferral_time
parameters.awaits: SLA terms per class; deferral is Tier 2 and ships disabled
parameters.description: Longest a Leg may be deferred before deferral stops being an admissible outcome.

parameters.name: assign.max_consecutive_deferrals
parameters.awaits: observed deferral chains in shadow mode
parameters.description: How many rounds in a row one Leg may be deferred before it escalates.

parameters.name: plan.max_bundle_size
parameters.description: Maximum Legs per column. At 1 the round is in the singleton regime.

parameters.name: plan.max_columns_per_round
parameters.description: Column budget for one round; exhaustion is reported as the column-generation gap.

parameters.name: plan.max_exhaustive_stops
parameters.description: Stop count below which stop ordering is solved exhaustively rather than heuristically.

parameters.name: plan.commitment_horizon
parameters.description: How far ahead work is committed. Validated against cost.opportunity.value_horizon, which must exceed it plus the maximum admissible mission duration.

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: Queue depth: the number of concurrent HARD commitments one agent may hold. Ships at 1 — the singleton regime of §1.8 rule 3. Enforced by a partial unique index, not only by application logic.

parameters.name: route.degraded_max_radius
parameters.description: Maximum candidate radius permitted while routing is degraded, where travel-time estimates are unreliable.

parameters.name: route.degraded_reserve_factor
parameters.description: Reserve inflation applied while routing is degraded. A degradation multiplier: it enters the combined degraded conservatism product, not the nominal one.

parameters.name: degraded.max_duration
parameters.awaits: a safety decision per degraded mode
parameters.description: Time box on any degraded mode. Every suspension of an invariant is explicit, named, and expires.

parameters.name: degraded.max_last_known_age
parameters.description: Oldest last-known agent state a degraded mode may reason from.

parameters.name: ops.stranded_safe_response_target
parameters.description: Response target for an agent stranded in a position that obstructs nothing.

parameters.name: ops.stranded_restrictive_response_target
parameters.description: Response target for an agent stranded where it restricts but does not block passage.

parameters.name: ops.stranded_obstructing_response_target
parameters.awaits: a safety decision with the local highway or site authority
parameters.description: Response target for an agent stranded obstructing a public right of way — the case that drives external escalation.

parameters.name: ops.suspension_review_period
parameters.description: How often a SUSPENDED Task must be reviewed rather than left suspended indefinitely.

parameters.name: ops.escalation_capacity
parameters.awaits: the region's actual staffed operator count
parameters.description: Concurrent human escalations ladder steps 7–8 can absorb. Without it the ladder's human steps are an unbounded promise.

parameters.name: ops.escalation_saturation_period
parameters.description: Window over which escalation capacity saturation is measured.

parameters.name: observability.full_retention
parameters.description: Retention of full-fidelity Tier A decision records. Input-snapshot retention must be at least this, or a retained record becomes unreplayable.

parameters.name: observability.compact_top_n
parameters.description: How many top candidates a compact Tier A record retains in full.

parameters.name: observability.tier_b_sample_rate
parameters.description: Sampling rate for full-fidelity Tier B records.

parameters.name: observability.tier_b_retention
parameters.description: Retention of sampled Tier B records.

parameters.name: observability.tier_b_write_budget
parameters.description: Bounds the Tier B exemption list so shard-wide degradation cannot force full retention.
